biography: Vijayaraghavan M. Chariar is a Professor (HAG) at CTIKS, IIT Bombay, on lien from IIT Delhi. His work connects traditional knowledge with sustainable design, frugal innovation and community well-being. His research spans wellness, traditional arts and crafts, and water and sanitation.
researchOverview: Research focuses on community-based work in wellness, arts and crafts, and water and sanitation. Projects connect traditional knowledge with sustainable design, skills training and local enterprise.

reviewNotes: All imported content was collected from the user-specified IIT Bombay website and its linked patent certificates, except publisher notices used only to exclude retracted entries.

The main page explicitly lists IIT Bombay from 2026 and IIT Delhi through 2026. An undated bio/CV modal retains IIT Delhi contact information; the dated main-page timeline and IIT Bombay footer are used instead.
PhD year 1998 and historical position dates follow this requested site; the earlier IIT Delhi CV is not reused.

Publication entries are transcribed from visible category cards, not from the previous CV. Items marked under review/expected, repeated-title metadata conflicts, and two publisher-confirmed retractions are withheld in the companion evidence file.
Bibliographic metadata follows the faculty website; it has not been independently certified by every publisher.

The site links five course plans. Two have detailed content but no dated teaching assignment; three say their syllabus is being compiled. No current or previous delivery is inferred; course plans remain in the source evidence only.
Only four names explicitly listed as doctoral scholars on JoyLab are imported. No student topics, graduation years or alumni are inferred from the previous source.
Five granted patents use the certificate titles, numbers and dates. Older application entries duplicating these grants are not duplicated. In-process applications without a number remain withheld.
The original accounts, portraits, visibility and faculty directory order are preserved.
